name: menzies-design-wash-ui-monorepo
description: Menzies Design Wash UI monorepo (library + demo)

scripts.dev:clean: rm -rf node_modules/.vite apps/demo/node_modules/.vite && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build -w @menzies-mariesta-com/menzies-design-wash-ui && npm run build -w @menzies/wash-demo
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @menzies-mariesta-com/menzies-design-wash-ui && npm run mcp:build && npm run build -w @menzies/wash-demo
scripts.flutter:generate: dart run tool/sync_wash_version.dart && dart run tool/wash_tokens/generate.dart && dart run tool/wash_atmosphere/generate.dart && dart run tool/wash_style_spec/generate.dart && dart run tool/wash_lucide/generate.dart && dart run tool/generate_gallery_manifest.dart && dart run tool/generate_gallery_pages.dart
